text: The v3 real court completed all 20 forks, then correctly rejected aggregation because GraKeL's independent warmed processes chose different valid batch sizes at the calibration boundary. Receipt aggregation had wrongly required one batch size for every fork. Reworked receipts to preserve a batch-size vector and normalize every fork independently; clustered bootstrap now consumes those normalized fork samples. Moved calibration after warmup so it represents steady state and uses a 120 ms target below the 100 ms no-batching boundary, retaining margin above the 30-second evidence floor. Court 15/15, JVM worker 15/15, GraKeL 4/4, GraphKernels.jl 8 row-boundaries, Ruff pass.
